bias.en: Bearish · oversold, broke $227, at the January lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，跌破 $227，位于 1 月低点

read.en: Teradyne fell 15.2% on Nov 5 to $212.74, trading between $211.63 and $242.05 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($253.7), 10-day ($282.0), 30-day ($349.8) and 100-day ($369.1) averages and the rising 200-day ($349.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($282.85), and RSI is 22, oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月5日下跌 15.2%，收于 $212.74，盘中区间 $211.63–242.05，成交量明显放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$253.7）、10 日（$282.0）、30 日（$349.8）和 100 日均线（$369.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$349.9）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$282.85），RSI 为 22，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $245.9–246.8, $238.8–240.7 and $227 supports, all now resistance; the close sits on the January lows. Resistance is $227, then $238.8–242.1 (Jan 29–Feb 2 lows, Nov 5 high) and $245.9–246.8. Support is $211.6–212.6 (Nov 5, Jan 5 and Jan 8 lows), then $199.3–200 and $193.4 (Dec 31 low). A close above $227 would target $239–242; below $211.6, $200.

s.en: Nov 5 low $211.63; Jan 5 and Jan 8 lows ($211.8–212.6)
